resources.string: Clear browsing data when Orbis is closed

When you swipe Orbis out of your recent apps, or it is stopped, Orbis clears your open tabs, history, cookies, site data and cache the next time it starts, before any page loads. Bookmarks, saved passwords, downloads and settings are kept. Switching to another app does not clear anything.
Orbis keeps these sites\' cookies, so you usually stay signed in. Their other stored data is still cleared.
Enter a site name, like example.com
